```kotlin
import java.util.*

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val hpy = sc.nextInt()
    val atky = sc.nextInt()
    val defy = sc.nextInt()
    val hpm = sc.nextInt()
    val atkm = sc.nextInt()
    val defm = sc.nextInt()
    val h = sc.nextInt()
    val a = sc.nextInt()
    val d = sc.nextInt()

    var min_cost = Int.MAX_VALUE

    for (add_atk in 0..200) {
        for (add_def in 0..200) {
            val new_atk = atky + add_atk
            val new_def = defy + add_def
            val dmg_to_monster = maxOf(0, new_atk - defm)
            if (dmg_to_monster <= 0) continue
            val rounds = (hpm + dmg_to_monster - 1) / dmg_to_monster
            val dmg_to_yang = maxOf(0, atkm - new_def)
            if (dmg_to_yang >= hpy) {
                val needed_hp = dmg_to_yang * rounds - hpy + 1
                if (needed_hp < 0) continue
                val cost = add_atk * a + add_def * d + needed_hp * h
                if (cost < min_cost) min_cost = cost
            } else {
                val cost = add_atk * a + add_def * d
                if (cost < min_cost) min_cost = cost
            }
        }
    }

    println(min_cost)
}
```

import java.util.*

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val hpy = sc.nextInt()
    val atky = sc.nextInt()
    val defy = sc.nextInt()
    val hpm = sc.nextInt()
    val atkm = sc.nextInt()
    val defm = sc.nextInt()
    val h = sc.nextInt()
    val a = sc.nextInt()
    val d = sc.nextInt()

    var min_cost = Int.MAX_VALUE

    for (buy_atk in 0..200) {
        for (buy_def in 0..200) {
            val new_atk = atky + buy_atk
            val new_def = defy + buy_def
            val dmg_to_monster = maxOf(0, new_atk - defm)
            if (dmg_to_monster == 0) continue
            val rounds = (hpm + dmg_to_monster - 1) / dmg_to_monster
            val dmg_to_yang = maxOf(0, atkm - new_def)
            val needed_hp = rounds * dmg_to_yang
            val buy_hp = maxOf(0, needed_hp - hpy + 1)
            val cost = buy_atk * a + buy_def * d + buy_hp * h
            if (cost < min_cost) min_cost = cost
        }
    }

    println(min_cost)
}
